svg.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

g.text: A multi-gate model of radioiodine failure in thyroid cancer
An eight-gene differentiation / iodide-handling axis linking discovery to RAI-labelled validation cohorts

svg.text: Need: a parsimonious molecular readout to triage RAI candidates before therapy
Current biomarkers (BRAF · RAS · TERT) do not reliably partition the RAI-refractory population.
NIS alone is insufficient — coordinated differentiation across all four gates is required.

g.text: Three molecular states along the eight-gene differentiation–silencing axis

svg.text: SLC5A5 · TPO · TG · TSHR · PAX8 · NKX2-1 · FOXE1 · DIO1
genomic modifiers · secondary, not the main axis

g.text: Tiered evidence ladder · discovery → validation → stratification

svg.text: Tier-4 discovery → parsimonious 8-gene panel → label-anchored validation → three-class stratification
Positioned as a risk-stratification readout — prospective Tier-1 confirmation is the next step.
